dyed-flax-fibres-georgia.research_focus: the Dzudzuana Cave flax fibres of Upper Palaeolithic Georgia and how hunter-gatherers twisted plant fibre into cord
dyed-flax-fibres-georgia.scene: Inside a firelit cave, a pair of hands rolls thin plant fibres against a thigh into a twisted thread, a bundle of stripped wild flax stems beside them

silk-weaving-china-legend.research_focus: the legend of Leizu and the silkworm cocoon falling into tea, and early Chinese sericulture
silk-weaving-china-legend.scene: A robed noblewoman in a palace garden lifts a single fine thread from a cocoon floating in a cup, a mulberry tree overhead; a legend, painted as one

victoria-white-wedding-gown.research_focus: Queen Victoria's 1840 wedding dress of satin and Honiton lace and the Chapel Royal ceremony
victoria-white-wedding-gown.scene: A young queen seen from behind walks up a chapel aisle in a pale satin gown with a long lace-trimmed train and a wreath of orange blossom; likeness by posture, not face

worth-paris-couture-house.research_focus: Charles Frederick Worth's salon on the Rue de la Paix and Second Empire crinoline gowns
worth-paris-couture-house.scene: In a gas-lit Paris salon, a model in a vast crinoline gown turns slowly while a seated lady studies the dress and a tailor kneels to adjust the hem

burberry-gabardine.research_focus: Thomas Burberry's gabardine twill, Victorian outerwear, and the later trench coat
burberry-gabardine.scene: Rain beads and runs off a belted gabardine coat hung on a peg in a draper's shop, bolts of tightly woven twill stacked on the counter below

viscose-rayon-patented.research_focus: Cross, Bevan and Beadle's viscose process: wood pulp, cellulose solution and spinnerets
viscose-rayon-patented.scene: In a Victorian laboratory, a thick syrupy cellulose solution is drawn through a small nozzle into a glass bath, emerging as glossy silk-like filaments wound onto a spool; logs and pulp sit on the bench

lacoste-polo-shirt.research_focus: René Lacoste's short-sleeved cotton piqué tennis shirt of the 1930s and the clay courts of the era
lacoste-polo-shirt.scene: A short-sleeved piqué tennis shirt with a small embroidered crocodile on the chest lies folded on a bench beside a wooden racket, a clay court behind; no people

hepburn-givenchy-black-dress.research_focus: the Givenchy sheath gown, long gloves and pearls from the opening of Breakfast at Tiffany's, and Fifth Avenue at dawn
hepburn-givenchy-black-dress.scene: A sleek floor-length sheath gown with long evening gloves and a multi-strand pearl necklace on a dress form, before a jeweller's shop window on an empty city avenue at dawn, a paper coffee cup and pastry on the sill; no people

monroe-sheer-birthday-dress.research_focus: the Jean Louis gown covered in rhinestones worn at Madison Square Garden for President Kennedy in 1962
monroe-sheer-birthday-dress.scene: A skin-tight sheer gown glittering with thousands of hand-sewn crystals stands on a dress form under a single spotlight on an empty stage, a microphone stand beside it; no people

von-furstenberg-wrap-dress.research_focus: Diane von Furstenberg's printed jersey wrap dress of the 1970s and the office life of the era
von-furstenberg-wrap-dress.scene: A patterned jersey wrap dress tied at the waist hangs on a dress form beside a 1970s office desk with a typewriter and a briefcase; no people

diana-revenge-dress.research_focus: Christina Stambolian's off-the-shoulder silk chiffon dress worn to the Serpentine Gallery in June 1994
diana-revenge-dress.scene: A fitted off-the-shoulder silk chiffon cocktail dress with an asymmetric hem on a dress form, a pearl choker at its neck, before a gallery entrance lit by press camera flashes; no people

jlo-green-versace-dress.research_focus: the Versace silk chiffon dress with a jungle-leaf print and plunging neckline at the 2000 Grammy Awards
jlo-green-versace-dress.scene: A sheer silk chiffon gown printed with tropical jungle leaves, its neckline plunging to the waist, on a dress form on a red carpet with camera flashes all around; no people

lady-gaga-meat-dress.research_focus: Franc Fernandez's dress of raw flank steak at the 2010 MTV Video Music Awards
lady-gaga-meat-dress.scene: A dress stitched together from slabs of raw beef, with matching meat boots and a small meat hat, on a dress form under stage lights; no people, nothing gory
